newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsukoshi declines comment on new outlet report.
newsitem.headline: Mitsukoshi declines comment on new outlet report.

text.p: Japanese department store operator Mitsukoshi Ltd on Wednesday declined to comment on a newspaper report that it would open a huge outlet in Osaka by 2001.

The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said in its evening edition on Wednesday that Mitsukoshi is planning to open an outlet with a sales floor of about 50,000 sq metres in front of West Japan Railway Co's Osaka station.

"We have no comment on the report," a Mitsukoshi spokesman said. "We hear that there is a plan that a large store will open facing Osaka station, but we have not told the newspaper that it will be ours," a Mitsukoshi spokesman said.
But he added: "We have a plan from more than 10 years ago that we would like to have a core store in Osaka."
